question: A:B = 3:4, B:C = 6:7, C:D = 14:15. What is the ratio A:D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the ratio of the first and last terms directly, multiply all intermediate ratios.

A/D = (A/B) × (B/C) × (C/D)

A/D = (3/4) × (6/7) × (14/15)

A/D = 252 / 420 = 3 / 5

**∴ The correct answer is 3:5.**
